title: 29 CFR 1910.132 — General requirements for personal protective equipment
jurisdiction_scope: US federal general industry where Subpart I applies
role_scope: employer PPE hazard assessment, selection, communication and training
notes: Supports hazard-based PPE selection and employer responsibility. It does not create a universal live-event high-visibility rule.

title: 29 CFR 1910.133 — Eye and face protection
jurisdiction_scope: US federal general industry where applicable
role_scope: affected employees exposed to covered eye/face hazards

title: 29 CFR 1910.135 — Head protection
jurisdiction_scope: US federal general industry where applicable
role_scope: affected employees exposed to covered head hazards
notes: Requires protective helmets where falling-object head injury potential exists. This section does not establish high-visibility apparel requirements.

title: 29 CFR 1910.138 — Hand protection
jurisdiction_scope: US federal general industry where applicable
role_scope: affected employees exposed to covered hand hazards
notes: Requires appropriate hand protection based on task, conditions and hazards; not a universal glove-for-every-task rule.

title: 29 CFR 1910.95 — Occupational noise exposure
jurisdiction_scope: US federal general industry where applicable
notes: Supports occupational-noise controls/hearing-protection context; exact requirements depend on exposure and applicable program provisions.

title: 29 CFR 1910.242 — Hand and portable powered tools and equipment, general
jurisdiction_scope: US federal general industry where applicable
model_product_scope: covered hand and portable powered tools/equipment
role_scope: employer responsibility for safe condition of covered tools/equipment
notes: Supports safe-condition responsibility; it does not create authority to operate unfamiliar or controlled tools.
